title: 8 CV Rules That Double Your Interviews (From 39,184 CVs)
description:
Why your CV isn't getting interviews, and the 8 things that actually move the needle, based on a study that analysed 39,184 real CVs. Tailoring, summary numbers, bullet depth, page length, certifications, education, experience bands, and employment gaps. Including the one rule that flips depending on your career stage.

Whether you call it a CV or a resume, these are the eight things that actually change your interview rate, and most of them are the opposite of the advice you've been given.
